evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet scanning code in src/wallet/scan.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
rationale: Parallelizes BIP 157/158 compact block filter evaluation during wallet fast rescans across worker threads, addressing slow rescans with a 3x to 6x measured speedup. Benchmarks confirmed runtime drops on 200k blocks from ~272s to ~38s on 8 threads, significantly improving user experience during wallet restores and imports without impacting serialized block reading or sync correctness.
